cluster.heading: Cluster serving
cluster.idle_peers: Visible but not in this run
cluster.page.title: Cluster
cluster.page.subtitle: Run one model across several Macs. Each machine keeps serving its own models alongside it.
cluster.page.off_title: Clustering is off on this Mac
cluster.page.off_body: Turn it on below, then set the same cluster key on every Mac you want to join.
cluster.nodes_hint: Rank order is the cabling, not a display choice.
cluster.no_peers: No other Mac is advertising oMLX on this network yet.
cluster.no_peers_hint: Start oMLX on the other Mac with clustering enabled and the same cluster key.
cluster.key_mismatch_hint: This Mac is running oMLX clustering with a different key, so it will not join.
cluster.missing_model: Model not found on this node
cluster.config.enabled_hint: Off by default. While off, this daemon never advertises itself and never spawns a rank.
cluster.config.key_hint: A shared secret. Every Mac in the cluster needs the same value. Only a truncated hash of it is broadcast.
cluster.config.model_hint: The one model served by the whole fleet. It must be downloaded on every node.
cluster.config.backend_hint: Auto picks the fastest transport the cabling and RDMA state allow, and falls back to TCP.
cluster.config.max_batch_hint: How many requests may decode together across the cluster.
cluster.config.discovery_interval_hint: How often this node scans for peers, in seconds.
cluster.config.pipeline_hint: Pipeline instead of tensor sharding. No model supports this yet; leave it off.
cluster.config.busy: The cluster is serving a request. Tear it down first, or wait for it to finish.
cluster.config.restart_hint: Applied without a restart. Forming happens the next time the sharded model is loaded.
cluster.follower_hint: This Mac holds ranks for a cluster led by another Mac. Configuration is locked until that cluster is torn down from its leader.
cluster.missing.title: This model is not on every node yet
cluster.missing.body: {peers} cannot join until it has {model}. This Mac can send it directly over the local link — no upload, no download from the internet.
cluster.missing.no_repo: {model} has no source repository, so it can only be copied from this Mac. That is the normal path for a model you quantised yourself.
cluster.download.heading: Copying to peers
cluster.download.forming: Weights are in place — starting the cluster…
models.incomplete_tooltip: Only {present} of {expected} weight files are on disk. This model will fail to load until the rest are downloaded.
